protocol.weighting: Sum complete request wall times, one request per primary case per repetition; guards excluded and reported separately.
protocol.generation_guard: 512 forced tokens; not scored as a complete quality answer
protocol.cached_guard: Identical priming request immediately precedes the guard; require the guard to serve at least 90% of its prompt from cache and report both counts
protocol.timing: Client-observed first nonempty content and terminal response, not prompt_ms as a TTFT proxy

scope: Synthetic record extraction from pinned public project documentation, not arbitrary long-context quality
